short_description: Search, extract, and compare high-quality public sources.
description: Use Exa Search to discover sources and Exa Contents to extract selected URLs.

install.prompt: Use $exa-deep-search to research a topic with source-backed findings.
install.cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill exa-deep-search --agent codex
install.global_cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill exa-deep-search --agent codex --global

examples: Research the competitive landscape for AI agent observability.
Find the last 30 days of reliable sources about a topic and give a five-source brief.
Compare public arguments for and against a technical architecture with citations.
notes: Search before extracting; use exa_contents only for selected sources.
If exa_contents is unavailable, return search results and note the extraction gap.

schema_resolution.dynamic_lookup: Resolve the capability by capability_id and render its current inputSchema.

endpoints.summary: Discover web sources with optional highlights, summaries, or text.
Extract selected URLs as clean text, highlights, summaries, or subpages.
